goal: Make bitcoin-wallet's dump command fail and clean up instead of silently producing a truncated backup file
Protects users who rely on wallet dumps as backups from unknowingly having an incomplete, unusable dump

why: P2 because a silently truncated wallet backup can leave a user with an unusable recovery file
Affects backup integrity, which is treated as high priority just below direct fund-loss bugs
Also closes a durability gap where even a fully written file could be lost before fsync
